title: The Mission of São Rafael
summary: The Tapajós, the wet season 2776. The swarm comes out of the flooded forest at Father Tomasz's mission village. Bring the people to the river fort.

sides.name: The Mission
sides.about: Father Tomasz, Brother Tiago and the mission's militia at São Rafael; the river fort down the trail.

sides.name: The Swarm
sides.about: The creatures out of the flooded forest: a forward Mother, her Sires, Raptors and flyers.

objectives.text: The church of São Rafael must stand until the people leave it.

THE FIRST NIGHT: the people in the three fields can't hear the bell. Send a soldier or Father Tomasz to each field: its people run for the church when one of yours reaches them. In the churchyard: {sheltered} of {field_n}.
objectives.phone: Fetch the people from the three fields: {sheltered} of {field_n} at the church.

objectives.text: THE HAMLET: ride out along the causeway (west) to Santa Luzia. Drive the Raptors off: its people come out of the chapel and follow your men back to the church ({hamlet_in} of {hamlet_n}).
objectives.phone: Santa Luzia (west, the causeway): drive the pack off, bring its people back ({hamlet_in} of {hamlet_n}).

objectives.text: The chapel at Santa Luzia holds for {clock:hamlet}.
Drill the CAVALRY CHARGE at the river fort's Horse Breeder (far down the trail: select it on the map). A Horseman's first blow after a gallop then hits more than twice as hard on light creatures.
Shoot down the flyers over the village: where they circle, the pack follows ({hatch_left} left).

THE ROAD TO THE FORT: the people follow Father Tomasz. Walk him down the trail to the river fort and keep the column covered: at the fort {at_fort} of {people_n}. The flood on both sides is the creatures' road, not yours.
objectives.phone: The people follow Tomasz: walk him to the river fort. At the fort {at_fort} of {people_n}.

objectives.text: The fort shuts its gate at dusk: {clock:column}.
A forward Mother has rooted on the mud bank in the north flood. While she lives every wave is bigger. Kill her if you can spare the men.

THE RAID: break the church of São Rafael, or catch more than half of the people before they reach the river fort: caught {dead_p} of {people_n} (more than {half} wins). Lay eggs on your Mother's card; the granary feeds whoever holds it.
objectives.phone: Break the church, or catch more than {half} of {people_n} people ({dead_p} now).

options.label: BURN THEM
options.about: The swarm finds nothing to eat here: its waves come no bigger. The people come home to ashes.

options.label: LEAVE THEM
options.about: The people's bread for their return. The swarm will feed on it: its waves come bigger.

k_open1.text: After Minas, Tomasz asked for the hardest place in Brazil. They sent him up the Tapajós.

k_open2.text: In the wet season of 2776 he met the swarm, before any of us in Rome knew what it was.

t_open1.text: São Rafael. Thirty families, a church of timber, fields on the dry ground above the flood.

t_open2.text: Brother Tiago taught the catechism in his own tongue. I taught it in Portuguese, and the children laughed at my accent.

t_open_many.text: Word of Rome had come up the river before me. They trusted me before I had earned it.

t_open_minas.text: I had left Minas uneasy. I thought the frontier would be quieter.

t_open_fled.text: Ramos was somewhere in the south by then. I prayed for him on the boat.

t_open3.text: That year the river came up into the forest and did not go down.

k_open_s.text: Tomasz tells that night as a priest. Here it is from the flooded forest, where nobody was keeping count.

f_open.text: The wet season. The forest stands in the river. The pack is hungry, and the village smells of grain and smoke.

ti_bell.text: They are out in the fields, Father. In this rain they will not hear it.

n_lesson.text: The people in the three fields can't hear the bell. Send a soldier or Father Tomasz to each field: its people run for the church when one of yours reaches them.

n_varzea.text: Your men wade the flooded forest at half pace. The creatures go through it as fast as on dry ground. Keep to the dry paths.

t_field.text: To the church! All of you! Leave the baskets!

n_w1.text: Something comes out of the flood at the west field. Raptors.

n_w2.text: More come out of the flood at the north field.

n_w3.text: And at the river field, by the landing.

ti_in.text: Everyone from the fields is in the churchyard, Father. The children too.

n_push.text: They come up the bluff for the churchyard. Hold the line on the bluff.

t_pray.text: Kneel, all of you, and stay down. Let the men shoot over you.

t_dawn.text: Dawn. I have never been so glad of a grey sky.

n_dawn_late.text: Dawn. Whoever was still out in the fields runs in now, if they can.

n_relief.text: Horses on the trail from the south: the relief from the river fort.

c_arrive.text: Captain Sobral, of the river fort. Your canoe reached us yesterday. We rode all night.

c_small.text: The Governor's purse is thin since Minas. I could bring only a few.

t_hamlet.text: Santa Luzia. The hamlet on the causeway. Nobody came in from there.

ti_hamlet.text: My sister's family is there. They will have gone into the chapel.

n_hamlet.text: Ride out along the causeway (west) to Santa Luzia. Drive the Raptors off, and its people come out and follow your men back.

c_charge.text: My horsemen are drilled for the charge, if the fort gives them the time. A charge breaks the small ones like reeds.

n_charge.text: Select the river fort's Horse Breeder (down the trail) and press CHARGE: the drill needs nobody there.

n_charged.text: The Charge is drilled. Gallop your Horsemen into the light ones.

n_hatch.text: Small flyers circle over the village. Where they circle, the pack follows.

c_hatch.text: Shoot those birds down! They are not birds.

n_hatch_down.text: The flyers are down. The pack comes on blind.

n_free.text: The people of Santa Luzia come out of the chapel. They follow your men back along the causeway.

ti_found.text: They hid in the chapel all night. They prayed the whole time, my sister says.

n_flank.text: The flyers still circle over you: more of the pack comes at the causeway out of the flood.

n_probe.text: A few come up at the village while your riders are away.

n_hamlet_late.text: The chapel at Santa Luzia is broken. Nobody comes out.

ti_back.text: They are in, Father. All we could find.

n_mother.text: In the north flood a big one has rooted on the mud bank: a forward Mother. While she lives, every wave is bigger than the last.

c_sire.text: And that Sire beside her. My men call him the Lindqvist Sire. They say he came out of the doctor's cages.

c_cannot.text: We cannot hold this, Father. Not with these men. The fort can.

t_go.text: Then we go. Everyone. The old ones in the middle.

n_road.text: The people follow Father Tomasz. Walk him down the trail to the river fort, and keep the column covered.

c_burn.text: Burn the fields and the granary, Father. Leave them nothing to eat.

t_bread.text: That is the people's bread for the winter.

ti_choose.text: They ask you to choose, Father. They will do what you say.

q_fields.text: Captain Sobral would burn the fields and the granary so the swarm finds nothing to eat. They are the people's bread for the winter.

t_left.text: No. It is their bread. We will hold them off with powder.

n_burned.text: The fields and the granary burn behind the column.

n_fed.text: Behind the column the swarm comes up into the fields and feeds. Its waves come bigger.

n_wave.text: They come out of the flood at the column.

c_mother_dead.text: The big one in the flood is down! They come slower now.

n_fort.text: The first of the people reach the river fort.

t_hurt.text: I am hit. Keep them walking, Tiago.

t_lead.text: Stay close to me. Do not look into the water.

n_gate.text: Dusk. The river fort shuts its gate. Whoever is still on the trail is left to the flood.

n_church_down.text: The church of São Rafael falls with the people in its yard.

n_all_lost.text: Nobody of São Rafael is left alive.

f_1.text: Your Mother is rooted on the mud bank. Lay eggs on her card: Raptors by the Tyrant Sire, flyers by the Storm Sire.

f_2.text: The flood is your road: your creatures cross it at full pace, the men wade it slowly. The granary feeds whoever stands round it.

f_relief.text: Horses on the trail from the south: the men from the river fort.

f_road.text: The people leave the bluff and go down the trail in a long line.

f_won.text: The column breaks in the flood. Nobody counts what is left.

f_lost.text: The fort's gate shuts on the last of them.

f_mother_dead.text: The Mother is dead. The pack scatters into the flood.

t_end1.text: We came through the fort's gate at dusk, and I counted them.

t_end_many.text: Most of them were there. I counted twice to be sure.

t_end_some.text: Some of them were there. I named the others that night, on my knees.

t_end_few.text: Few of them were there. I have their names still.

t_end_burned.text: Behind us the smoke of the fields stood over the forest all night.

t_end_left.text: Behind us the fields stood green in the rain. The swarm fed on them all season.

k_end1.text: A priest, a catechist and a handful of dragoons brought a village through the flood.

k_end_left.text: He would not burn the poor's bread. My soldiers paid for that bread on the Tapajós for years. I would have done the same.

k_end_burned.text: He burned the poor's bread to starve the swarm. He has confessed it every year since. It was a hard thing, and he chose it.

k_end_s.text: That is not how it went. Tomasz brought them to the fort. Hear it again from him.

new_dragoon.text: NEW: THE DRAGOON. A Musketeer on a horse: he rides fast down the trails and fires on foot. The relief brings four; the river fort's Barracks trains more beside its Horse Breeder.

new_charge.text: NEW: THE CAVALRY CHARGE. Drill it at a Horse Breeder: a Horseman's first blow after a gallop hits more than twice as hard on light creatures, and throws them back.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King tells it.

village.caption: São Rafael, on the Tapajós, the wet season 2776.

dragoons.caption: The relief from the river fort.

crown.title: The River Fort
crown.text: {at_fort} of the {people_n} people of São Rafael reached the river fort.

text_if.text: The fields and the granary were burned behind them.
The fields were left standing for their return. The swarm fed on them.
The forward Mother on the mud bank was killed.

swarm.title: The Flood
swarm.text: Of the {people_n} people of São Rafael, {dead_p} never reached the fort.

text: The Tapajós, the wet season 2776. You are Tomasz's mission village of São Rafael: Father Tomasz, Brother Tiago and the mission's militia.

Something hunts in the flooded forest round the village. First bring the people in from the fields to the church; then the relief rides up from the river fort, and the hamlet of Santa Luzia must be fetched.
Then lead everyone down the trail to the river fort. Men wade the flood slowly; the creatures do not.
The Tapajós, the wet season 2776. You are the swarm in the flooded forest: a forward Mother rooted on a mud bank, her two Sires and a pack.
The village on the bluff has grain and people. Break its church, or catch more than half of its people before they reach the river fort down the trail.
